-- ============================================================
-- test-10-ensures_pos.fh  –  ensures PASS-Tests (ENS-01..09)
-- ============================================================
module Test.Ensures.Pos

import Test.Support exposing Point, make_point

error NotFound

-- ENS-01: Einfache ensures
function double_it(n: Integer) returns Integer
requires n >= 0
ensures result >= n
is
    return n + n
end double_it

-- ENS-02: result auf Record-Typ
function make_origin() returns Point
ensures result.x = 0, result.y = 0
is
    return make_point(0, 0)
end make_origin

-- ENS-02: result mit Arithmetik
function increment(n: Integer) returns Integer
requires n >= 0
ensures result = n + 1
is
    return n + 1
end increment

-- ENS-03: success in ensures
function always_ok(n: Integer) returns Result<Integer, NotFound>
requires n >= 0
ensures success, value >= n
is
    return ok n
end always_ok

-- ENS-04: failure in ensures
function always_fail(n: Integer) returns Result<Integer, NotFound>
requires n >= 0
aborts NotFound
ensures failure
is
    abort NotFound
end always_fail

-- ENS-05: Array-Index in ensures
function make_pair(a: Integer, b: Integer) returns Array<Integer, 2>
requires a >= 0, b >= 0
ensures value[0] = a, value[1] = b
is
    return [a, b]
end make_pair

-- ENS-05 EDGE: letzter gültiger Index
function make_triple(a: Integer, b: Integer, c: Integer) returns Array<Integer, 3>
requires a >= 0, b >= 0, c >= 0
ensures value[0] >= 0, value[2] >= 0
is
    return [a, b, c]
end make_triple

-- ENS-06: Mehrfeldiger Pfad
function point_with_x(x: Integer) returns Point
requires x > 0
ensures result.x = x, result.y >= 0
is
    return make_point(x, 0)
end point_with_x

-- ENS-07: Bibliotheksaufruf in ensures
function tag_string(s: String) returns String
requires String.instr(s, "") = 0
ensures String.instr(result, "TAG") >= 0
is
    return String.replace(s, "X", "TAG")
end tag_string

end Test.Ensures.Pos
